scope: corner truth restoration, current PnP directional error, trajectory fit, PnP residual scaling, and simple state/prediction baselines
research_state: offline evidence complete; production predictor remains paused

metric_contract.hit_plane: fronto-parallel plane at future truth camera depth
metric_contract.hit_plane_boundary: optimistic geometry proxy; no plate obliquity, ballistics, latency, dispersion, or control error

prediction_ablation_contract.truth_usage: pairing, scoring, and controlled residual scaling only
methods: ordinary-least-squares constant velocity in camera XYZ

corner_intervention.finding: the unchanged IPPE and coordinate chain closes under exact corners; measured corner geometry and planar conditioning dominate the large pose tail

current_visible_paired_pnp.boundary: conditioned on a retained PnP/truth pair and truth-visible plate; excludes zero detection and wrong association

pnp_improvement_decision.criterion: P95 absolute horizontal miss at future truth depth <= 55 mm
pnp_improvement_decision.translation: current PnP passes at 50/100/200 ms in the offline oracle-identity cohort
pnp_improvement_decision.rotation: current PnP passes at 50/100/200 ms on supported visible arcs; high-rate long-horizon coverage remains sparse
pnp_improvement_decision.combined_50ms: tested grid requires at least 25 percent PnP residual reduction
pnp_improvement_decision.combined_100_200ms: exact PnP still fails; measurement improvement alone cannot satisfy the gate

interpretation_boundaries: 55 mm is the current yaw gate, not a complete two-dimensional fire-control budget
small-armor rectangle proxy omits obliquity and system error
combined 100/200 ms conclusions have only 34/13 retained samples
a summary or percentile never replaces the point-level compressed CSV distributions
